title: Varda media slot
description: A square-cornered media slot: a real image or video fills it like object-fit: cover; empty, it is a flat navy-lighter surface with a faint warm light in one corner, so it reads plainly as a placeholder. Anything passed as children (a play button) sits centred on top.
notes: size it from outside (aspect-*, h-full); it fills its box
name: varda-placeholder

props.name: media
props.description: a real image or video; it is stretched to cover the slot. Empty: a plain token surface

props.name: children
props.description: chrome laid over the slot, centred (e.g. a play button)

props.name: label
props.description: what the slot will show, for screen readers (only used while it is empty)
